summary.text: Andrea Kirby, a Working Class Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 10th District to Christina Hines.
She had appeared on general-election ballots for U.S. House in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Kirby ran for U.S. House in Michigan's 9th District in 2018 and 2020.
She ran in Michigan's 10th District in 2022 and 2024, and in 2024 she received 2.6% of the vote as the Working Class Party candidate.
The Working Class Party nominated her at its convention on June 6, 2026.
She received 1.1% of the vote to Christina Hines's 52.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
